---
name: CI build and test
# Schema: https://json.schemastore.org/github-action.json

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      container:
        type: boolean
        description: "Running in docker container"
        default: false
      os:
        type: string
        description: "The operating system of the runner"
        default: 'ubuntu-24.04'  # Default used for container
      gcc:
        type: string
        description: "The GCC version to use"
        required: true
      python-version:
        type: string
        description: "The Python version to use"
        required: false  # Only needed if not in container
      upload-app:
        type: boolean
        description: 'Upload the standalone application'
        default: false
      tag:
        type: string
        description: "The tag to apply"
        required: true
      tag_message:
        type: string
        description: "The tag message to use"
        required: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  gcovr-ci-job:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.container && 'ubuntu-24.04' || inputs.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      SPHINX_SKIP_CHECK_LINKS: "True"
      FORCE_COLOR: "1"
      NOX_CONTAINER_ARGUMENTS: >-
        ${{ inputs.container && format(' --session docker_run_compiler({0}) --', inputs.gcc) || '' }}
      GENERATE_DOCUMENTATION: >-
        ${{ inputs.container && contains(fromJSON('["gcc-5", "gcc-6", "gcc-7", "gcc-8", "gcc-9", "clang-10"]'), inputs.gcc) }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 75
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare package version
        uses: "$/.github/actions/prepare-package-version"
        with:
          tag: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          tag_message: ${{ inputs.tag_message }}

      - name: Set up runner
        uses: "$/.github/actions/setup-runner"
        with:
          os: ${{ inputs.os }}
          gcc: ${{ (!inputs.container && inputs.gcc) || '' }}
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

      - name: Set up environment
        run: |
          # Enable coverage for specific target configurations
          if [ "${{ inputs.container }}" == "true" ] ; then
            case "${INPUTS_GCC}" in
              gcc-5)    USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              gcc-8)    USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              gcc-14)   USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              gcc-15)   USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              clang-10) USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              clang-20) USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              *)        USE_COVERAGE=false ;;
            esac
          else
            case "${INPUTS_OS}/${INPUTS_GCC}/${INPUTS_PYTHON_VERSION}" in
              ubuntu-24.04/gcc-11/3.14) USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              windows-2025/gcc/3.14)    USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              macos-15/gcc/3.10)        USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              macos-26/gcc-15/3.14)     USE_COVERAGE=true ;;
              *)                        USE_COVERAGE=false ;;
            esac
          fi
          echo "USE_COVERAGE=$USE_COVERAGE" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          # Set the CC environment
          echo "CC=${INPUTS_GCC}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          INPUTS_GCC: ${{ inputs.gcc }}
          INPUTS_OS: ${{ inputs.os }}
          INPUTS_PYTHON_VERSION: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install '.[dev]'
      - name: Run tests
        env:
          SPEAKEASY_ENABLE_GDB_TESTS: "1"
        run: pytest tests/
